One candidate (avgo_2024_7_D021) merely lists restructuring charges as a component of cost of revenue without detail. The other candidate (avgo_2024_7_D053) details $1,533 million in charges primarily related to the VMware Merger cost reduction activities, which differs from the '2024 Restructuring Plan' focus on AI/enterprise alignment (AMD) or general headcount/capital rationalization (INTC) found in the target and other peers. The scope and primary driver (VMware vs. strategic AI/enterprise or general cost structure adjustment) are distinct enough to avoid direct comparison of the specific '2024 Restructuring Plan' topic.

comparisons.peer_summary: In 2024, Intel announced a Restructuring Plan involving headcount reductions, real estate consolidation, and capital rationalization to adjust to current business trends, resulting in $2.8 billion in restructuring charges and an expected 15% decrease in the core workforce by early 2025.
comparisons.comparison: Both AMD and Intel disclosed significant restructuring charges in fiscal year 2024 driven by a specific '2024 Restructuring Plan' aimed at cost reduction and strategic alignment. AMD recognized $186 million in charges to drive efficiencies and align resources with AI and enterprise growth opportunities. Intel recognized a substantially larger amount of $2.8 billion in charges under its 2024 Restructuring Plan, which involved headcount reductions, real estate consolidation, and capital rationalization. Both companies framed these charges as necessary adjustments to current business trends and strategic priorities.

sentences.text: We recognized $186 million of restructuring charges in 2024 due to the implementation of a restructuring plan (the 2024 Restructuring Plan).
The 2024 Restructuring Plan was focused on driving efficiencies across the business and aligning resources with our largest growth opportunities in the AI and enterprise markets.
The headcount actions in connection with the 2024 Restructuring Plan are expected to result in an approximate 15% decrease in our core Intel workforce by early 2025.
As a result of initiating and deploying our 2024 Restructuring Plan, we recognized restructuring charges of $2.8 billion in 2024.
